scope: Choose and prepare provider-neutral coding executor interface only; no scheduler/provider implementation, provisioning or paid launch

baseline.sourceDifference: cloud-runner/server-core source unchanged since original study; current study commit pinned

laneRule: Every RunSpec declares all4lanes; required flags exactly match packet manifest. Selected lane must be required. Linux/macOS/provider executors may contribute separate receipts; required pending lane never waived.
authorityRule: Existing coordinator/manifest/Git integration and completion gate remain authority; executor reports compute/artifacts only. Prepared file grants no credentials or active lease.

candidates.shape: Existing integration coordinator exports immutable RunSpec to isolated external coding runner; authenticated transport reports outcome/proofs back.
strengths: No product-domain or Electron dependency for coding gate
costs: Need adapter, credential broker and durable run reconciliation implementation
candidates.cheapestFalsification: Fixture executor with readonly prepared spec; simulate create-response timeout, duplicate payload, lost lease, stale SHA and unowned diff; demonstrate coordinator rejects invalid outcomes.

candidates.shape: CodingExecutor adapter maps new RunSpec into existing CloudRunProvider transport and artifacts; does not stuff trust claims into free-form metadata.
strengths: Existing UI run panel/status/cancel and provider adapters
costs: Generic RunSpec does not enforce Git/ref/lease/receipt
Idempotency after failure differs Local vs Daytona
Artifact done cannot become feature verified
candidates.cheapestFalsification: Fake CloudRunProvider sends done with no commit or wrong input; coding adapter must stay pending/deny, plus identical runId different payload must conflict.

candidates.shape: User-local durable harness owns dispatch/reconcile queue and calls same external executor protocol; macOS worker can supply native lane.
strengths: Local continuity and macOS device lane fit existing operator environment
costs: Personal host availability and private-vault boundary
Harness status is not code executor proof; source/private policy must remain isolated
Requires cloud adapter/receipt binding despite local durability
candidates.observedProbe: harnessctl.py status read-only returned version2.0.0; no request, worker or cloud execution launched; private session details not persisted
candidates.cheapestFalsification: Restart fake dispatcher after lost response; confirm one remote run, preserved lease fencing and no local private files/credentials forwarded.

operations.name: submit
operations.input: preparedHandle + authenticated scheduler dispatch envelope with active lease/fencing
operations.output: stable runHandle; duplicate same request returns same attempt
operations.effects: Proposed isolated executor only; not implemented here

operations.name: events
operations.effects: Deduplicate by eventId; no exactly-once provider transport claim

operations.name: cancel
operations.output: cancel-request acknowledgment; terminal only after cleanup confirmation
operations.effects: Revoke capability/lease then cancel provider; lost if provider unknown

operations.name: resume
operations.output: checkpoint resume or new explicit attempt handle
operations.effects: Never mutate input/spec on old attempt; prior events retained

operations.name: collect
operations.effects: Realpath, size, hashes, Git diff and ancestry checked before review

practicalGaps: No executor adapter currently consumes coding RunSpec
No authenticated lease/credential broker or distributed fencing implementation in prepared folder
No durable request digest/event sequence/reconciliation store
No repo checkout/default-branch guard or code-output import implemented by existing prompt runner
Completion validators verify future evidence; prepared packets do not cause execution
No exact external image digest/model/provider tenant selected; fixture values deliberately inert
Per-run lane fragment aggregation and verification-role proof-only lease enforcement; canonical receipt single writer

freeze.changeRule: Schema/lease/packet/screen changes require new specDigest and regenerated fixture; previously active attempt reconciled, not retargeted

sourceEvidence.claim: Existing prompt/model/limits artifact run spec lacks first-class coding checkout/lease/branch/receipt fields.
Existing compute states/cancel/artifacts/event subscription; no coding review or integration protocol.
Duplicate active/done IDs return existing handle; failed IDs may proceed to new sandbox without payload hash comparison.
Sandbox seeds /run/spec.json and artifacts, executes rox-run, imports artifacts then deletes; this path does not implement Git checkout/ref proof.
Local any existing run ID returns existing state; detached subprocess watchdog and dead PID reconciliation are reusable mechanisms.
Adapter delegates run RPC; coding constraints require an explicit adapter implementation.
Prompt-pack generator returns research subtasks and metadata; not a Git coding request.
HTTP provider transports generic RunSpec; REST transport can carry an adapted request only after coding capability conformance.

fixtureSnapshotPolicy: Historical inert fixture; current manifest changes require freshly prepared real RunSpec, never automatic retarget or active authorization.

laneAggregation.codingOwner: One implementation role owns source changes and outputCommit; verification roles operate same immutable subjectCommit with proof-only lease.
laneAggregation.receiptWriter: Existing coordinator assembles canonical WP completion receipt; workers return unique run/lane fragments, never race overwrite canonical receipt.
laneAggregation.binding: Verification checkout inputSha equals verificationOf.subjectCommitSha; preserve implementationInputSha and implementation run receipt hash. Required lanes all bind same subjectCommit/input/spec before acceptance.
laneAggregation.proofIsolation: Each run/attempt uses proof/macro-integration/WP-ID/runs/runId/; all artifact/event/checkpoint/outcome paths stay under that unique prefix, canonical receipt path is read reference only.

validation.scope: Contract schema/source fixture only; no provision/checkout/credential resolution/remote run. Mutation checks target schema sensitivity, not future executor implementation.
